statement: Model: one walk from spawn in a uniformly random direction (THEORY.md 1). Hard bounds: geometry error 0, rounding at most 0.5 blocks (included). Random part: except with chance at most 1e-06 over the seeds (A1, A2), every range below holds at once (Theorem 20). The lower end of every E[D] range needs nothing more; the upper end also uses H_C (constant hazard from C/2 on), which affects only the tail share. Biome ties: the game's pick at an exact climate tie depends on its lookup history, so every range is taken from the earliest possible hit (lower end) to the latest possible hit (upper end) (Lemma 30), and holds whatever the game picks; the estimate uses the fixed hint free rule.
